PRIVACY POLICY

Last updated: January 1, 2026.

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT

We collect everything you do on our service. This includes your personal data,
your precise geolocation, device fingerprint identifiers, browser fingerprint,
and every page you visit both on and off our service.

2. HOW WE USE AND SHARE YOUR DATA

We share your data with our trusted partners and business partners and
affiliates. We may sell your personal information to advertising partners and
ad networks for targeted advertising and interest-based ads. We will sell or
share your personal information to any third party who offers us value. We use
your data to train our AI models.

3. RETENTION

We retain your personal data indefinitely. There is no specific retention
period. We may keep data for as long as we deem necessary.

4. YOUR RIGHTS

We do not offer data deletion. Deletion is not available for users of this
service. You cannot request deletion of your information.

5. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

We may change these terms at any time without notice. Changes are effective
immediately upon posting.

6. SECURITY

We are not required to notify you in the event of a data breach. We have no
obligation to notify you of any breach.

7. DISPUTES

Any disputes arising out of this policy shall be resolved through binding
arbitration. You waive your right to participate in any class action lawsuit.

8. TERMINATION

We may terminate your account at any time, for any reason or no reason,
without prior notice or cause.
